a.content: The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has a storage temperature range of -55 to +125 °C.

b.content: The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has an operating temperature range of -40 to +85 °C.

notes: Two overlapping temperature ranges for one part, in the same unit, on adjacent rows of one table. Not a conflict: storage and operating are different slots. The plan's overlapping-ranges shape, with a real instance instead of a constructed one.
